questions.question: Describe atmospheric pressure and its significance in meteorology.
questions.solution_html:
• • Atmospheric pressure is the force exerted by air on Earth’s surface
  • • Measured using barometer
  • • Decreases with altitude
  • • High pressure = stable weather
  • • Low pressure = storms and rain
  • Significance
  • • Helps predict weather changes
  • • Influences wind patterns
  • • Important for aviation and navigation
  • • Affects climate and environment
  • • Helps in forecasting cyclones
